quick_skim.title: HeatTok: Enhancing Remote Sensing Image Understanding via Thermodiffusion-based Tokenization
quick_skim.abstract: Current visual tokenizers in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly rely on patch-based partitioning, which causes severe semantic mixture and object fragmentation in remote sensing imagery due to the irregular contours of geo-objects. Moreover, existing adaptive methods struggle to extract precise object-level tokens and lack dedicated geometric positional encodings for irregular regions. In this paper, we propose HeatTok, a semantic-aware tokenizer driven by thermodiffusion aggregation. Inspired by the physical principles of heat conduction, HeatTok adaptively merges adjacent homogeneous regions to generate semantically independent, object-aligned irregular tokens. To enable MLLMs to perceive these irregular shapes, we design the Gaussian Multimodal Rotary Positional Embedding (G-MRoPE), which models token spatial distributions via 2D Gaussians and explicitly injects center, scale, and orientation cues. Extensive evaluations on the VRSBench and EarthVQA datasets demonstrate that HeatTok effectively preserves object-level semantic integrity and achieves state-of-the-art performance under a reasonable token budget. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/HeatTok.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: HeatTok proposes a thermodiffusion-based semantic tokenizer that generates object-aligned irregular tokens and geometric positional encodings for remote sensing images in MLLMs; it directly supports multimodal remote sensing image understanding and classification, though missing-modality handling is not covered.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在遥感影像理解中因分块标记导致语义混合和地物碎片化的问题，提出基于热扩散聚合的语义感知标记器HeatTok。它自适应合并相邻均质区域，生成与地物对象对齐的不规则标记，并设计专用几何位置编码以感知不规则形状。实验表明HeatTok能提升MLLM在遥感影像上的理解与分类性能。该方法直接服务于多模态遥感图像分类，但未涉及缺失模态学习，故有一定相关性。
